 -display none -daemonize -pidfile /app/vm/qemu.pid > /app/vm/qemu.log 2>&1; sleep 3; cat /app/vm/qemu.log; ls -l /tmp/ser.sock; cat /app/vm/qemu.pid

cat > /app/vm/drive.py <<'EOF'
import socket, sys, time, re
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX); s.connect('/tmp/ser.sock'); s.settimeout(1)
buf=b''
def rd(t):
    global buf
    end=time.time()+t
    while time.time()<end:
        try:
            d=s.recv(65536)
        except socket.timeout: continue
        if not d: break
        buf+=d; sys.stdout.write(d.decode('utf8','replace')); sys.stdout.flush()
def wait(pat,t=300):
    global buf
    end=time.time()+t
    while time.time()<end:
        if re.search(pat,buf.decode('utf8','replace')): return True
        rd(2)
    return False
def send(x):
    s.sendall(x.encode()+b'\n'); time.sleep(0.3)
EOF
